title: Chapter 7157: Real?

Chapter 7157: Real?

Chapter 7157: Real?

“Ahh!” Screams could be heard from all timelines. When Li Qiye pulled his hands back, the shattered totems were revealed.

These primordial totems defined toughness. However, they couldn’t resist and could only scream before disappearing. Their essences returned to the surging sea of wisdom.

“They died just like that?” The dragon servants dropped to the ground and murmured.

Although they hated the divine beasts for betraying them, this didn’t mean the perpetual respect could go away in a few days. However, Li Qiye refined them into life liquid effortlessly.

“Sir, you are quite cruel.” The illusory voice couldn’t save them.

“I stomped five insects versus refining trillions. It’s to send a message.” Li Qiye smiled: “Now, will you come out, or do I have to break this place up?”

“Will you kill the innocent as well?” The voice asked.

“If we must talk about innocence, the divine beasts are not innocent for having enslaved a world. The dragon servants will cheer at their death.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“If I appear, you will not harm the divine beasts?” The voice eventually answered.

“In my eyes, the divine beasts are no different than humans or demons. I am here for you, not the race. Of course, I don’t mind destroying them either.” Li Qiye said.

“I suppose it would be rude of me not to appear after your long journey.” The voice said.

A young man emerged in space and became the center of the universe. Laws came into being because of him; great worlds rose and fell under his dominion. All living beings and the endless cycles were subjected to his whims.

He had a tall and imposing stature. His broad shoulders could bear the heavens while his hands grasp all things. He appeared to be the source of life, evident by his majestic life aura.

The dragon servants couldn’t believe it and had to wipe their eyes.

“Impossible...” An immortal said.

After a long while, the overlords and immortals prostrated and shouted with utmost reverence: “Your Majesty!”

The man was none other than Skykiller True Dragon, the highest being of the divine beasts. They had accepted his death long ago and now, they were battling internally. Was he the one behind their fate?

Should they revere or despise him?
